goal: Make Qt unit test output visible in Windows CI logs
Developers can see and debug Qt unit test failures that were previously suppressed

categories.name: build
why: P3 because Qt unit test diagnostics are completely lost in Windows CI logs without a console
Affects developers trying to diagnose CI failures on Windows runners

categories.name: tests
why: P3 because unit test failures on Windows cannot report diagnostic errors or results
Restores observability for the Qt unit test suite in CI environments
